candidate.definition_en: To sit on and control the movement of an animal or vehicle.
candidate.explanation_ar: يركب ويسوق حاجة زي العجلة أو الحصان أو الموتوسيكل.

senses.definition_en: To sit on and control a bicycle, motorcycle, or animal.
senses.definition_ar: يركب ويقود دراجة أو حصاناً أو ما شابه.
examples: You can ride a horse at the farm.

senses.definition_en: To travel as a passenger in a vehicle such as a bus or train.
examples: Many students ride the bus to school every day.
You can ride a horse at the farm.
Many students ride the bus to school every day.
candidate.mnemonic: زي الاسم.. 'Ride' يعني يركب على الطريق 'Road'.
